subject.title: feat(plugins): add final tool input policies

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `registerFinalToolInputPolicy` and `requiredFinalToolInputPolicies` as permanent public Plugin SDK and operator configuration contracts?
rationale: This choice establishes a compatibility-sensitive security boundary and intentionally fail-closed operational behavior; code correctness alone cannot determine whether those permanent product contracts should be supported.

options.title: Adopt the contract
options.body: Approve the restrict-only final-input policy seam, then require refreshed current-main integration, upgrade documentation, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Reduce the public API or operator configuration surface after defining the minimum stable security context needed by external policy engines.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause this draft and keep the canonical issue open until the broader provenance and security model is decided.

recommendation.title: Adopt the contract
recommendation.body: Approve the restrict-only final-input policy seam, then require refreshed current-main integration, upgrade documentation, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current-main history across the adjacent trusted-policy, plugin registry, and execution-boundary code.
